headline: OPTIMUS PRIME VOICE ACTOR DIES AT 85
body: Peter Cullen, the voice of Optimus Prime, died Wednesday at 85, his representative confirmed to People. His family said he passed peacefully at home in Los Angeles, surrounded by loved ones. Cullen first voiced Optimus Prime in 1984 and carried the role across animated series, films and games for decades.
